# Changes from the original experiment code

The scripts in `methods/`, `src/`, `evaluation/` and `cpmr_experiment/*/scripts/` are the files that produced the results of the paper. They were copied with **only** the text edits listed below (paths, model identifiers, credential paths, default arguments, wording). No formula, tokenization, template, scoring, optimizer, schedule or seed logic was changed.
Docstrings keep the numbers of the internal experiment log they were written for; those numbers carry no meaning outside the author's log.

## 2. Files added

| file | purpose |
|---|---|
| `src/apocf_prompt.py` | the ESCI APO-CF meta-prompt (template and the shorter / similar / bare constraints) copied verbatim from the original rewriter of the APO-CF implementation, so that the paper's PO stage no longer depends on a second repository; rebuilds all 18 recorded meta-prompts (T1–T3, 3 variants, Qwen and Llama) byte for byte |
| `methods/esci_loss_train_245.py` | trainer of the Qwen3-4B ESCI mixed objectives = `esci_loss_train_mix_fo.py` plus `--alpha` (AnyLoss slope, default 10 = the paper value) and `--loss mixbce` (token CE + label-margin BCE) used by the pilot of Appendix B. For `--loss mix` / `mixany` with the paper settings it is the trainer of the main study: the loss values of the first three updates of the stored seed-0 runs were reproduced to four decimals. The earlier files `esci_loss_train_mix.py` (T1) and `esci_loss_train_mix_fo.py` (T2–T7, PO) are not shipped; their code is contained in this file |
| `scripts/restore_data.py`, `scripts/verify_data.py`, `scripts/make_ckpt_map.py`, `scripts/make_manifests.py` | restore / verify the inputs from the ID manifests; checkpoint map; the author-side tool that wrote the manifests |
| `data/manifests/` | ID manifests and checksums (no dataset text) |
| `experiments/make_commands.py`, `experiments/commands/*.sh` | the command list of the paper |
| `analysis/` | analysis, statistics and panel scripts (copied from the analysis tree; only the `--mods` default and one import path were adapted to the repository layout) |
| `checks/run_checks.py` | CPU smoke checks |
| `cpmr_experiment/*/p1_T*/…`, `cpmr_experiment/esci_llama/audit/max_length.json`, `cpmr_experiment/gemma231/sample_manifest.json` | frozen outputs that are inputs of later stages (PO selection, Base selection scores, Llama input limit, Gemma appendix sample) |

Default row files of the ESCI trainers/evaluators were changed from the earlier 1,000-query / 20-products-per-query freeze (`sft_rows.jsonl`, `test_rows.jsonl`) to the files of the paper (`sft2_rows.jsonl`, `test300_rows.jsonl`); every command of the study passed them explicitly.

## 3. What was checked against the original files (CPU)

| check | result |
|---|---|
| ESCI row files rebuilt from the ID manifests, official parquet files and the Qwen3 tokenizer | `sft2`, `diag`, `sel`, `test300`: SHA-256 identical to the originals |
| MS MARCO training pair file rebuilt from the manifest with `ir_datasets` | SHA-256 identical to the original (10,000 rows) |
| TREC-DL 2019 / 2020 judged pairs | 42 q / 1,102 and 54 q / 1,432 pairs; the rebuilt judged pool rows are equal to the judged rows of the original pool files; the judged-id hash printed by the evaluation matches |
| Qwen3-4B MS MARCO passage cache rebuilt with `build_passage_cache.py` from the restored pairs | 10,000 of 10,000 entries content-identical to the cache used for training; the training context loads from it; 1,200 rendered inputs identical |
| APO-CF meta-prompts | 18 of 18 identical to the recorded ones (text and SHA-256) |
| `analysis/auc61_kappa.py` run from the repository on the original score tree | `kappa.pkl` byte-identical to the stored one (630 cells) |
| 6.2 / 6.3 analyses (`err62_main.py`, `err63_main.py`) run from the repository on the original score tree | see `checks/analysis_reproduction.md` |
| `esci_loss_train_245.py` | CPU unit checks of the loss changes; first three updates of `mix` and `mixany` reproduce the stored training losses to four decimals; gradient identities (λ = 0 → CE exactly; CE+BCE gradient = CE + standalone BCE) |

Not checked: a complete training run started from this repository on a clean machine (needs GPU time not used for this package). The ESCI/MS MARCO restore and the analysis were verified against the original working tree; the training and evaluation scripts are the originals with the edits above.
